source.note: The archives were packed from this tree: d265f35d with three release fixes on top (editor-threejs declares react-dom; installed contribution packages CommonJS imports prebundled). main carries each fix as its own commit.

publication: Sixteen of seventeen versions are live: every registry shasum matches its tested archive and every tarball downloaded with no credentials is byte-identical to it. @volter/model-editor 0.5.67 was accepted by npm publish and is held by the registry as a staged version (a republish answers 409 "previously staged version"; npm stage list shows nothing to approve), so the model editor latest stays 0.5.66. First publication of @volter/dawproject and @volter/editor-dawproject.

checks.packedImports: 1169 files across 8 packages (modeling); 2318 files across 17 packages (game), after declaring the SDK CodeMirror imports and editor-threejs react-dom
checks.servedModules: served-bundle table matches the template and catalog (16 packages); runtime image carries every template and catalog dependency (36)

packedAcceptance.game: Runtime image installed from the seventeen archives with no workspace links; create linked it; a fresh empty game took add music under a live session (packages, player, render tool, skill, piece finder), opened the Harbor example from the package, rendered it through project.music.render with sections (32 files, no problems, -18 LUFS, each recorded in .vgai/provenance.json), and a note drag undid byte-identically; a game-template project played and rendered its scene. Found and fixed on the archives: the piece document failed on any install (CommonJS typescript and react-reconciler/constants served raw from node_modules).
packedAcceptance.modeling: The eight archives installed with no links; a model project from the packed product opened cube.blend; a Blender edit moved Cube to x=1.5, undo returned it to 0 and redo to 1.5; console silent.

installation.path: npx -y @volter/game-editor@0.5.67 create reg-game installed the runtime image from the registry, downloaded the pinned game workbench anonymously (sha256 matches the pin), and started a session; add music, the Harbor example, a render through the tool with provenance and a drag with undo all worked from that install.

audit: The model editor installs with 0 vulnerabilities. The game runtime image reports 8 (5 low, 3 moderate), all through colyseus -> @colyseus/auth -> grant/request-oauth (uuid, elliptic via jwk-to-pem); no upstream fix exists.
limitations: See WORK.md for the game editor's remaining list.
